carry-gates.status: Built 2 parts, RangeBox_r2_Layout, RangeBox_r2_Carrier_Carrier and RangeBox_r2.SLDASM, reusing the 4 parts already built; no interference between the gears in any mode, where they stand. Its turning gears are mated to turn in each of its 3 modes, one configuration each (H, N and L), and SolidWorks reports no mate in error in any of them: it opens in H; to switch mode, double-click another mode's configuration in SolidWorks' ConfigurationManager. Drag Sun in SolidWorks and the rest of its train follow. RangeSlv slides along Output, to its place in each mode. The 3 copies of Planet turn on Carrier, and RangeBox_r2_Carrier_Carrier holds Carrier's axes and planes only: a plate and pins are yours to add. Ring stays fixed where it is placed: its shaft does not turn. A turn you give the gears in one mode can show in other modes, so a dog can stand across its sleeve in another; to put the gears back there, press Update SolidWorks with that mode showing. 1 thing to do by hand: Assign a material to each of the 2 parts; the build leaves it unset. Gear Generator has not yet been shown to carry your work into a new revision on SolidWorks 2026 (findings.CARRY_INSERTS_ON_2026), so your Chain-1, Sprocket-8, Chain-2, 14 other components and 31 mates stay in RangeBox.SLDASM, as read when this build began; RangeBox_r2 has none of them. As read at 03:18, your User Keyway Sketch and User Keyway stay in Gear_m1.25_N29, which Sun's new part replaces; RangeBox_r2 has none of them, nor anything added since. UserAxis9 is on Sprocket-9, which is suppressed in H, the mode RangeBox.SLDASM showed, so it could not be read and is not made again.

carry.question: Aux is new on Aux, which is new too, and Update SolidWorks adds a gear only on a shaft the layout part has, so the gearbox needs building again. Shaft Aux is new, and the layout part has no axis for it. Gear_m1.25_N29 (Sun): Flank changed from involute to arcs, which its values cannot carry, so it needs a new part. Build again as RangeBox_r2? That makes new parts for Sun (Gear_m1.25_N29_r2) and Aux (Gear_m1.25_N20), reuses 4 parts that have not changed and makes a new layout part, carrier part and assembly (RangeBox_r2_Layout, RangeBox_r2_Carrier_Carrier and RangeBox_r2.SLDASM). Nothing is overwritten, and RangeBox.SLDASM stays as it is on disk, but it shares the 4 reused parts: a later Update SolidWorks that changes one of them changes RangeBox.SLDASM too. As read at 03:18, RangeBox_r2 takes your Sprocket-2, Sprocket-4, Sprocket-1 and 14 other components and makes your 26 mates again in the modes each was on in. UserSunFace was on a face of Sun, and Sun's part is new because its Flank changed, so it is not made again. Your UserGear6 is made again if the press reads its gear ratio and which way it turns. Your UserGearRoot and UserGearFillet are made again only if the face of Sun each is on proves to be on Sun's axis, since Sun's part is new. Sprocket-9 was suppressed in the mode RangeBox.SLDASM showed, as read, so UserAxis9 on it could not be read: show a mode where Sprocket-9 is resolved before you press, or Sprocket-9 may not be carried and UserAxis9 is not made again. Your User Keyway Sketch and User Keyway stay in Gear_m1.25_N29, which Sun's new part replaces (its Flank changed). RangeBox_r2 holds what it carries unsaved. If RangeBox.SLDASM is closed, open it first unless this SolidWorks last saved it and its files, those files are where it says, and nothing of yours is open. Assembly features, display states and appearances stay behind; sub-assemblies come over rigid, pattern instances as components of their own.
